== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page from the old Players Committee forum (Internet Archive captures). Sources used: topic 5796 (posts 113117 and 113119, which repost Jim Colson's 2003 posts; post 83333, Brandon Ruck's 2005 list).
Placed on its own page: [[Squadron Members]] is a volunteer roster and does not cover Decipher prize programs.
=== Missing data ===
* Photographs of the shirts.
* Print runs marked with a question mark by Colson ("only 20?" for the finalist shirts) are given as he wrote them.
=== Left out ===
* Brandon Ruck's 2005 list also calls the Mentor shirts "Apprentice/Mentor Scenario" and the Cloud City and Bespin & Beyond shirts "Scenario" shirts; Colson's "Tournament Series" names are used.
* Which lines of Ruck's list are Colson's edits (they were in bold, which the capture does not show); the page says only that the list was edited by Colson.

* [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=114613#p114613 SWCCG T-Shirt Information], Jim Colson (Advocate) (22 December 2005)

* [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=248004#p248004 SWCCG T-Shirt Information], Randy Davis (dadoluke) (12 December 2007)

=== Left out ===
* Colson's opinion that the pre-release shirt would be rarer than the Gift of the Mentor and Luke shirts.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
